bundlingNotes: Buyer's $1,275 settlement fee is stated to include title exam, electronic storage/access, courier costs, and tax certificate. Seller's $550 fee includes notary fees, courier/wire costs, and e-document storage/delivery. Refinance's $975 fee includes 'Title Examination/Abstractor,' notary fees, and 'Settlement/Closing fee.' All three fees are explicitly flat/fixed regardless of transaction value, with title insurance premiums and transfer/recordation taxes billed separately. Notably the buyer fee ($1,275) is more than double the seller fee ($550) for the same company -- the largest buyer/seller settlement-fee asymmetry found in this survey to date, reflecting DC's heavier buyer-side title-exam and policy-issuance workload versus the seller's comparatively light payoff-coordination role.
transactionContext: Residential purchase (buyer), sale (seller), and refinance (borrower) settlement fees for Washington DC (refinance figure also covers parts of MD/VA suburbs); independent title/escrow company, richest itemized DC-area source found.
